title: Validation of BaseScope Probes Using Cell-Free Synthesized Protein Lysates and mRNA
author: Hartung, Zemella, et al.

steps.title: Prepare slides and barriers
steps.instruction: Make Superfrost microscope slides RNase‑free, apply RNase AWAY, incubate, dry, draw up to three 1 cm‑diameter hydrophobic barriers with the ImmEdge PAP Pen, and let the barriers dry completely before proceeding.

substeps.instruction: Under a fume hood, place Superfrost microscope slides on a clean surface.
Cover each slide with RNase AWAY and incubate for 5 min.
Wipe the RNase AWAY off the slide with a Kimwipe and let the slide air‑dry.
Using the ImmEdge Hydrophobic Barrier PAP Pen (included in the BaseScope Duplex Reagent Kit Intro), draw up to three 1 cm‑diameter circles on each slide to define reaction areas.
Allow the hydrophobic barriers to dry completely in the fume hood (ensure they are fully dry before the next step).

steps.title: Coat with Poly‑D‑Lysine and add sample
steps.instruction: Dilute Poly‑D‑Lysine 1:1 with 1× PBS, apply 50 µL to each barrier circle, incubate 1 h at room temperature (20 °C–25 °C) covered with a lid, rinse three times with distilled water, dry, then dispense 25 µL of pre‑diluted lysate or mRNA and dry the sample for ~45 min at room temperature under a lid.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1:1 dilution of Poly‑D‑Lysine in 1× PBS.
Add 50 µL of the diluted Poly‑D‑Lysine to each hydrophobic‑barrier circle.
Cover the slide with a lid (e.g., a cardboard lid from a tube storage box) and incubate for 1 h at room temperature (20 °C–25 °C).
Immerse the slide three times in distilled water, then allow it to dry in the fume hood.
Using a 100 µL pipette, dispense 25 µL of the pre‑diluted cell‑free lysate or in‑vitro‑transcribed mRNA dropwise into the center of each circle.
Cover the slide with a lid and let the sample dry at room temperature (20 °C–25 °C) in the fume hood for approximately 45 min.
